This matches the ground truth defect despite describing it from the opposite polarity (the verifier saw the corrupted version and correctly identified it contradicts the claim).

None of the findings detect this defect. Pred_id 3 discusses Eq. The ground truth concerns the semantic characterization of boundary features; no finding addresses this specific inconsistency.
